tickets.title: How do I connect Confluence to Figma?
tickets.summary: Anika wanted live Figma frames in a Confluence page. Tandem sent the steps from the Knowledge base and she confirmed it works.

thread.name: Anika Patel
thread.text: How do I embed a Figma frame in a Confluence page so it stays up to date?
Use the Figma macro: type /figma in the page, paste the frame's link, and pick Live embed. Your Figma account needs to be connected once, under Profile > Apps.

thread.name: Anika Patel
thread.text: Worked, thanks!
